scope: release, docker, playwright, and staging smoke operations evidence

playwright_smoke.ci_gate: open until installed GitHub Actions workflow runs this smoke on PR/main

docker_build_smoke.ci_gate: open until installed GitHub Actions workflow builds SHA-tagged images on PR/main

staging_smoke.runtime_status: requires real staging URLs plus release SHA, release notes, image refs, migration/config/observability/backup/rollback/security evidence, and seeded smoke records
staging_smoke.private_beta_gate: open until staging smoke passes with production-like dependencies

observability_smoke.runtime_status: local backend request-id, structured JSON access log, panic request-id, and metrics endpoint contracts are validated; staging logs/metrics/traces/dashboard import/alert evaluation remain open
observability_smoke.private_beta_gate: open until production-like observability evidence exists

security_scan_smoke.runtime_status: local dependency/image/secret scan wrapper; release blocking thresholds remain open
security_scan_smoke.private_beta_gate: open until dependency, image, and secret scans run in CI/staging release context

no_go_release_notes_renderer.runtime_status: renders current no-go release notes from gate fixtures and local ops drill summary
no_go_release_notes_renderer.gate_policy: checked-in no-go notes must match generated output and must not claim staging, private beta, or production completion

local_evidence_verification.release_notes_path: must exist locally and reference RELEASE_SHA
local_evidence_verification.observability_evidence: must exist locally and reference RELEASE_SHA
local_evidence_verification.rollback_evidence: must exist locally and reference RELEASE_SHA
local_evidence_verification.security_scan_evidence: must exist locally and reference RELEASE_SHA

post_deploy_smoke_go_no_go_contract.gate_policy: report decision remains no-go when smoke fails, required release evidence is absent or locally unverifiable, release-SHA-bound evidence does not reference the deploy SHA, private beta fixtures are blocked, or production do-not-launch fixtures are present
